model.rationale: Latimer holds a D+18 district with incumbency advantages, while Cinquemani shows no measurable fundraising or outside support. Markets price this heavily Democratic, and no evidence justifies moving from the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: Any unexpected polling showing a single-digit race or significant outside spending against Latimer would warrant a downgrade.

overview:
Westchester-area NY-16 is a strongly Democratic district, and first-term incumbent George Latimer is running for re-election after winning the seat in 2024. His Republican challenger, Joseph Cinquemani, has no reported fundraising or cash on hand, and no outside groups are active in the race.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the contest, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals, incumbency, and the lopsided money picture. Prediction markets give Latimer roughly a 96% chance of winning. The expected margin is about 24 points, consistent with a Safe Democratic rating, though the absence of polling keeps uncertainty somewhat elevated.
